# Vecto

> Vecto is the accountability operating system for independent fitness trainers. Binary calendar tracking of workouts, meals and steps enforces client consistency so trainers keep clients longer and win referrals.

Vecto positions itself as a high-performance coaching platform built on three archetypes — the Sage (objective data), the Ruler (non-negotiable rules) and the Jester (dry authority). No backdating, locked logs and a red/green calendar make client compliance visible.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Product overview, how it works, pricing, and the flywheel that grows a trainer's business.
- [Sign in / Sign up](/auth): Create a trainer or client account, or sign back in.
- [Terms](/terms): Terms of service, referral rules, and client plan agreement.
